title: Databricks connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Databricks SQL warehouse's settings, read by the native analytics family (`loams_connector_analytics::databricks`, CN2 Task 17) over the SQL Statement Execution API and the Files API. `token` holds a secret **name** (D189), exactly the manifest's `secrets`.

token.description: A personal access token or an OAuth access token (`Authorization: Bearer`); the OAuth M2M exchange is not built (R17.8). The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

query.description: The source's query, read as Arrow result chunks. Give it an `ORDER BY` for an exact resume (R17.9).

sink.description: The sink: each batch is uploaded as one Parquet file to a Unity Catalog volume (`overwrite=false`), then loaded with `COPY INTO` (`append`) or `MERGE INTO` (`merge`).

mode.description: `append` (`COPY INTO`, which skips a file it already loaded) or `merge` (MERGE on `keys`: an upsert). Both are effectively once.

statement_timeout_secs.description: How long a statement may run before the attempt is retried, in seconds.
